[PREFERENCE] User is looking for inspiration for their next art project.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in contemporary artists who work with mixed media, especially those who incorporate recycled materials.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested ten contemporary artists who work with mixed media and recycled materials:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. El Anatsui (Ghanaian) - Known for sculptures made from discarded materials like aluminum cans, copper wire, and wood.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Chiharu Shiota (Japanese) - Creates immersive installations using yarn, fabric, and found objects.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Marina DeBris (American) - Creates sculptures from plastic pollution, highlighting environmental impacts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Wenda Gu (Chinese-American) - Uses a wide range of materials, including human hair, for provocative installations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Nick Gentry (British) - Transforms obsolete technology into vibrant portraits and landscapes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Erika Marthins (Brazilian) - Creates large-scale installations using discarded materials like plastic bags and fabric scraps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Yang Yongliang (Chinese) - Combines traditional painting techniques with digital photography and found materials.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Lee Ufan (Korean) - Incorporates natural materials to explore the relationship between the individual and the environment.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Michael Landy (British) - Uses recycled materials to question consumer culture and the role of the artist.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Subodh Gupta (Indian) - Uses everyday objects to explore globalization, migration, and cultural identity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant encouraged the user to explore each artist's website, social media, and online exhibitions for deeper insights.  
[PREFERENCE] User expressed interest in Marina DeBris' work.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided information about Marina DeBris' creative process, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Collecting and sorting plastic debris from beaches, rivers, and oceans.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Documenting finds and using social media to raise awareness about plastic pollution.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Sorting materials by color, shape, and texture for cohesive pieces.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Creating sculptures and installations that often take the form of sea creatures.
